title: Rollback endpoint with idempotency + audit events
author: Benji Okafor
pr_description: Context: We’re adding a one-click rollback mechanism for Optimize configuration changes (batching/caching/quantization/routing knobs). This PR introduces the control-plane API endpoint to rollback a scope (route/model/customer deployment scope) to a prior known-good config version, with hard requirements around idempotency, concurrency safety, and enterprise-grade audit trails (motivated by SUP-2418 latency regression + SUP-2423 audit evidence requests). Changes: (1) New POST rollback endpoint: POST /v1/optimize/config/rollbacks with body {scope, targetVersionId, reason, ticketLink?}. The endpoint resolves targetVersionId, validates it is compatible with the requested scope, and enqueues a rollback apply job. (2) Idempotency: supports Idempotency-Key header (required for Console; strongly recommended for API). We persist a dedupe record keyed by (tenant_id, idempotency_key, endpoint) and return the original rollback operation on retries (including if the first request timed out). (3) Concurrency checks: adds optimistic concurrency via an expected_current_version_id field; if provided, we fail with 409 Conflict when the live version has moved (prevents “rollback the wrong thing” under concurrent apply). Also adds a lightweight scope lease check to avoid two rollbacks/apply jobs running simultaneously per scope (see notes in code; runtime-side locking is in ENG-4827 but this PR ensures we don’t even enqueue two jobs). (4) Audit events: emits optimize.config.rollback_attempted, optimize.config.rollback_started, optimize.config.rollback_succeeded, optimize.config.rollback_failed with consistent fields: actor, tenant, scope, from_version_id, to_version_id, operation_id, idempotency_key hash, request_id, and outcome/error_code. Events are emitted for both API and internal Console calls. (5) Failure-mode handling: if propagation is partial (some clusters updated, others not), the operation is marked FAILED with error_code=PARTIAL_PROPAGATION and includes per-target status; clients can safely retry with the same Idempotency-Key to resume/return the same operation. (6) Permissions: enforces optimize.config.rollback permission (RBAC wiring relies on existing authz middleware; full role mapping is in ENG-4830). API responses: returns a rollback operation object (operation_id, scope, requested_version_id, applied_version_id, state=PENDING|RUNNING|SUCCEEDED|FAILED, created_by, created_at) and includes a status_url for polling. Testing: adds unit tests for idempotency dedupe, expected_current_version_id conflict, permission denied, and audit emission; adds integration tests for retry-after-timeout and simulated partial propagation. Rollout: feature-flagged under optimize_config_history (server-side), disabled by default in prod; Console will only show the Rollback button when both flag + permission are present. Notes: This PR intentionally rolls back the whole config blob (no partial field rollback). Audit payload does not include full config contents; instead it logs version IDs and scope, with deep links to version history (to avoid leaking customer prompts/derived fields into audit streams).
commits: optimize/api: add rollback operation model + status enum
authz: enforce optimize.config.rollback permission on rollback endpoint
idempotency: persist idempotency records + replay prior responses
audit: emit rollback_* audit events with consistent schema + error codes
tests: add rollback idempotency + concurrency + audit unit tests
tests: integration tests for timeout retry + partial propagation simulation
docs(internal): add endpoint to API reference + curl examples
review_conversation: 2025-02-06 Chloe Martin: Can we make Idempotency-Key required? I’m worried Console will forget to set it in early builds and we’ll have double rollbacks when users double-click.

2025-02-06 Benji Okafor: I made it required in Console client, but kept it optional at API level for now (SDKs + some internal scripts). Added a warning log + metric when it’s missing; happy to flip to required once SDKs are updated.
2025-02-07 Kaitlyn Nguyen: Permission name looks good. Please ensure we return 404 vs 403 correctly for cross-tenant scope leakage. Also, are we hashing Idempotency-Key before writing audit logs?

2025-02-07 Benji Okafor: Updated: we now validate tenant scope before permission evaluation, return 404 for unknown scope within tenant, and we store idempotency_key_sha256 in audit (never raw). Added tests for both.
2025-02-07 Marcus Lin: Audit event payload should include request_id + operation_id always, and error_code should be a bounded enum. Also confirm we are not emitting config contents.

2025-02-07 Benji Okafor: Done: request_id + operation_id are required fields in the audit builder; error_code enum added (PERMISSION_DENIED, CONFLICT, VALIDATION_FAILED, PARTIAL_PROPAGATION, INTERNAL). No config contents emitted; only version IDs + scope + deep link.

2025-02-08 Neha Kapoor: For partial propagation, what’s the on-call story? If the operation is FAILED but some targets updated, can we safely retry? Please add a note in the API response and a metric we can alert on.

2025-02-08 Benji Okafor: Retry is safe with the same Idempotency-Key; we return the same operation and do not create a second one. Added response field failure_summary and metric optimize_config_rollback_partial_propagation_total.
2025-02-09 Allison Grant: Please add tags to the rollback metrics (tenant_tier, env, scope_type) and ensure audit events include region/cluster when applicable.

2025-02-09 Benji Okafor: Metrics now tag env + scope_type; tenant_tier is available in the auth context and is now included. Audit events include target selectors; per-target region/cluster is attached only for STARTED/FAILED/SUCCEEDED events to avoid huge payloads on ATTEMPTED.
2025-02-10 Chloe Martin: CI is green. I’d like a follow-up to require Idempotency-Key at API level once SDKs are updated, but fine for now. Approving.
2025-02-10 Marcus Lin: Approved after the audit schema updates.
2025-02-10 Neha Kapoor: Approved (please link the metric to ENG-4828).
merge_outcome: Merged to main; feature flag optimize_config_history remains off by default in prod environments.
release_notes: Added rollback API endpoint for Optimize config versions with idempotency and optimistic concurrency controls.
Emitted enterprise audit events for rollback attempts/outcomes with redaction-safe payloads.
Added failure-mode tests including partial propagation + retry semantics.
